title: RL training curves across six seeds with final-step spread
what: SAC-tuned 100k mean return (~840) or its lead over TD3-clip / PPO-base

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: SAC-tuned reaches 838 (±15 SD), ahead of TD3-clip by +89 and PPO-base by +134.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; SAC-tuned separates cleanly above both baselines outside ±1 SD by 100k steps.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: TD3-clip and PPO-base show wider seed-to-seed variance and partial overlap between themselves.
